* Topology: two super-source-followers (SSF) buffer vinp/vinn onto bridge
* resistor RBR (signal current = vd/RBR, SSF source impedance ~tens of ohms);
* the SSF shunt-PMOS current is copied 1:1 and folded through 3x NMOS

XM1N dn vinn sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8

circuit:
* cgm_amp -- constant-gm biased differential amplifier (Sky130 1.8 V devices)
*
* Signal path
*   Resistively degenerated NMOS pair (XMIP/XMIN with RS between the sources),
*   one tail current sink per side (XMTA/XMTB) and ideal resistor loads
*   (RLP/RLN) to VDD.  Drains are cross-assigned so the differential gain is
*   positive:
*
*       Ad = 2*RL / (2/Gm_in + RS),   Gm_in = gm / (1 + (gm+gmb)*RS/2)
*
* Gain stability over PVT
*   The beta-multiplier reference (XMN1/XMN2/RB closed by the XMP1/XMP2
*   mirror) pins its reference branch at gm1 = ln(K)/RB.  The tail sinks are
*   width-ratio M copies of XMN1, and the input devices carry M times the
*   reference current at the same W/L ratio, hence at the same inversion
*   level, so 2/gm_in tracks RB by construction.  Numerator and denominator
*   are then both ideal resistances and the gain reduces to a resistor ratio
*   that barely moves with process, supply or temperature.
*   The self-biased cell current is PTAT; XMSUB adds a fixed, iref-derived
*   offset to the reference branch whose 1/T weighting cancels the residual
*   positive temperature drift of gm_in.
*
* Output common mode
*   Vout,cm = VDD - Itail*RL is a resistor drop referenced to VDD, so it
*   follows the supply instead of a device threshold and stays inside the
*   required window at every corner.
*
* Bias startup and uniqueness
*   XMREF sinks the forced 50 uA reference and biases XMSUB, which pulls a
*   small always-on current out of the mirror diode node nb.  That destroys
*   the zero-current state of the self-biased loop, so the operating point is
*   unique for any solver seed and cold power-on settles in about 2 us.
*
* Symmetry
*   The two halves are device- and net-identical, so the deterministic output
*   imbalance is zero.

.subckt cgm_amp vss iref vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn

* ---- reference sink for the forced iref, and startup bias ----
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMSUB nb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1

* ---- constant-gm (beta multiplier) reference core ----
XMP2  nb nb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=3
XMP1  na nb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=3
XMN1  na na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=33.3333 nf=7
XMN2  nb na ns  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=133.333 nf=27
RB    ns vss 8900

* ---- degenerated input pair with resistor loads ----
XMIP  voutn vinp sa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
XMIN  voutp vinn sb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
RS    sa sb 1195
XMTA  sa na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=40
XMTB  sb na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=40
RLP   vdd voutp 5980
RLN   vdd voutn 5980

.ends cgm_amp

circuit:
* cgm_amp -- gain-stable differential amplifier (Sky130 1.8 V devices + ideal R/C)
*
* Topology: two-stage fully differential core inside a resistive feedback
* network.  Both quantities that must hold over PVT are pinned to things that
* do not move over PVT (ideal resistor ratios and the forced 50 uA reference):
*
*   Adiff  = RFA/RIA = 92.5k/25k = 3.70 nominal, reduced ~3% by the finite
*            loop gain (T ~ 30..90), giving 3.42..3.54 V/V over all PVT.
*   VDD-Vout,CM = (Itail2/2 + Ifb) * RL = ~30 uA * 9.1k = 250..284 mV, set by a
*            mirrored (hence PVT-independent) current in an ideal resistor,
*            so it tracks VDD one-for-one and needs no CMFB amplifier.
*
* Stage 1 (XM1A/B): nmos pair, pmos current-source load, R1A/B to VSS.  The
* interstage common mode is I_residual * R1 = (20u-12.5u)*140k ~ 1.05 V, i.e.
* ground referenced, so stage 2 keeps tail headroom even at VDD = 1.62 V.
* Stage 2 (XM2A/B): nmos pair with ideal load resistors to VDD; its low output
* impedance (9.1k) drives the 500 fF load and lets the feedback network stay
* small enough to keep the summing-node pole far above the loop crossover.
* CCA/CCB with nulling resistors RZA/RZB split the poles; the loop is flat to
* ~45-72 MHz with no peaking at any corner.
*
* Feedback is crossed (voutn -> xa, voutp -> xb) because the forward path has
* two inversions; this makes the differential gain positive and the loop
* negative.  The netlist is exactly symmetric side-to-side, so the zero-input
* differential output imbalance is deterministically zero.  All bias currents
* are simple ratioed mirrors of the forced iref, so cold start is monotonic
* with no latch state.  Total VDD current ~150..175 uA (262..344 uW).
*
.subckt cgm_amp vss iref vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn
* ---- bias: every current is a geometric ratio of the forced 50 uA iref -----
XMB0  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMT1  t1   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=5
XMT2  t2   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMPB  pb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8  nf=4
XMPD  pb   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMP1A n1a  pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMP1B n1b  pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
* ---- stage 1: nmos pair, current-source load, R sets interstage CM ---------
XM1A n1a xa t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=5
XM1B n1b xb t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=5
R1A n1a vss 140k
R1B n1b vss 140k
* ---- stage 2: nmos pair, ideal load resistors to VDD set the output CM -----
XM2A voutp n1a t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=25 nf=10
XM2B voutn n1b t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=25 nf=10
RLA vdd voutp 9.1k
RLB vdd voutn 9.1k
* ---- miller compensation with nulling resistors ---------------------------
CCA voutp za 150f
RZA za n1a 2k
CCB voutn zb 150f
RZB zb n1b 2k
* ---- feedback network: gain = RFA/RIA, crossed for negative feedback ------
RIA vinp xa 25k
RIB vinn xb 25k
RFA voutn xa 92.5k
RFB voutp xb 92.5k
.ends cgm_amp

circuit:
* cgm_amp - gain-stable differential amplifier (Sky130 1.8 V core devices).
*
* Topology
*   Resistively loaded NMOS pair with source degeneration.  Both quantities the
*   spec constrains are then ratios of ideal, drift-free elements:
*       gain          = Gm*RL,        Gm = gm/(1+(gm+gmb)*RDEG)
*       VDD-Vout,CM   = Id*RL
*   RL/RDEG are ideal resistors and Id is mirrored from the ideal 50 uA IREF
*   reference, so the output common mode is set by an I*R product that has no
*   process, supply or temperature drift of its own.
*
* Gain stability over PVT
*   At a fixed drain current gm(T) falls ~1.4x from -40 C to 125 C (process
*   contributes only ~1%), which alone would give a 1.39 gain spread.  The tail
*   current is therefore given a PTAT-shaped slope that cancels it: XMPA/XMPB
*   form a delta-Vgs cell whose output current is I = (|Vgs_XMPA|-|Vgs_XMPB|)/RB,
*   a Vth-cancelling difference that rises with temperature.  Degeneration
*   (Gm ~ 1.6x below gm) divides the residual gm error and linearises the pair.
*   The blend that sets the slope is the reference-leg current of the cell,
*   I_A = I(XMA0) + I(XMA1): the constant part comes from IREF and the PTAT part
*   from the cell itself, so the slope is trimmed by the XMA0/XMA1 ratio.
*
* Start-up
*   The reference leg is driven from IREF rather than from a mirrored copy of
*   the cell's own output, so I*RB = |Vgs_XMPA(I_A)| - |Vgs_XMPB(I)| has a single
*   solution (left side rising in I, right side falling, positive at I = 0).
*   There is no zero-current state and no start-up helper is needed; from a cold
*   zero-energy state the bias is settled well within 1 us of IREF appearing.
*
* Balance
*   The two halves are instance-for-instance identical and the bias enters only
*   through the common tail, so the zero-input differential output is exact
*   (< 1 nV in simulation); there is no deterministic imbalance mechanism.
*
* Operating point (tt, 1.8 V, 27 C): Itail 78 uA, Id 39 uA, gm/Id 21,
*   gain 3.50 V/V, BW 47 MHz into 500 fF, VDD-Vout,CM 256 mV, 292 uW.
*
.subckt cgm_amp vss iref vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn
* ---- IREF input diode: 50 uA reference ---------------------------------
XMR   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* ---- delta-Vgs cell reference leg: IREF part + PTAT part ---------------
XMA0  pa iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
XMA1  pa nb   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
* ---- delta-Vgs cell: I = (|Vgs XMPA| - |Vgs XMPB|)/RB, PTAT ------------
XMPA  pa pa vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMPB  nb pa sb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
RB    vdd sb 19.3k
XMND  nb nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
* ---- tail current: 10x the delta-Vgs cell current ----------------------
XMT   tail nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=10
* ---- degenerated input pair (non-inverting: vinp -> voutp) -------------
XMIP  voutn vinp sp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
XMIN  voutp vinn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
RDP   sp tail 520
RDN   sn tail 520
* ---- loads: set both the AC gain and the output common mode ------------
RLP   vdd voutp 6.55k
RLN   vdd voutn 6.55k
.ends cgm_amp

* Gain-stable differential amplifier (cgm_amp).
*
* Two-stage, fully-differential, resistor-feedback amplifier. Every branch
* current is defined by the external 50 uA reference through the NMOS
* current mirror (XM0/XMT1/XMT2), so power and operating points are
* essentially PVT independent; the closed-loop gain is set by an ideal
* resistor ratio and desensitized to devices by the loop gain.
*
*   Stage 1 : NMOS-LVT differential pair (XN1A/B) with ideal pull-up
*             resistor loads RL1A/B and a mirrored tail current.
*   Stage 2 : NMOS-LVT differential pair (XN2A/B) with ideal pull-up
*             resistor loads RL2A/B and a larger mirrored tail current.
*             Each stage inverts, so two stages give non-inverting gain;
*             the shunt-shunt feedback is therefore cross-coupled
*             (Rf from each output to the *opposite* input gate) to be
*             negative.
*   Feedback: R1/Rf set the closed-loop gain ~ (Rf+R1)/R1 = 4.33 V/V.
*   Comp   : Miller capacitors CCP/N across stage 2 set the closed-loop
*             bandwidth/stability.
*
* Output common mode is vdd - (tail2/2)*RL2, defined by the mirror current
* and an ideal resistor, so vdd - vout,cm is PVT stable (~0.34-0.38 V).
* No CMFB loop is needed, which guarantees cold-start self-biasing.
.subckt cgm_amp vss iref vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn
* Reference diode: IREF forces 50 uA through it (sets the mirror gate).
XM0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
* Mirrored tail currents for stage 1 (1.2x) and stage 2 (2.2x).

XMT2 t2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=4
* Stage-1 input pair.
XN1A d1p g1 t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=120 nf=24
XN1B d1n g2 t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=120 nf=24

RL1B d1n vdd 25k
* Stage-2 pair (gates driven by stage-1 drains).
XN2A voutp d1p t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=350 nf=70
XN2B voutn d1n t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=350 nf=70
RL2A voutp vdd 6.2k
RL2B voutn vdd 6.2k
* Cross-coupled shunt-shunt negative feedback.
R1P vinp  g1 30k
R1N vinn  g2 30k

RFN voutp g2 100k

* cgm_amp: PVT-robust differential gain stage.
*
* Topology
*   NMOS (LVT) differential pair XM1/XM2 with a mirrored tail XMT, loaded by
*   PMOS (LVT) triode loads XML1/XML2.  The load gates are driven from node nb,
*   which is generated by a diode-connected PMOS XMR (a replica of the load
*   device) carrying a fixed mirror fraction of iref.  XMB is the iref input
*   diode and XMN is the sink that fixes the reference-branch current.
*
* Why the gain is PVT stable
*   The load devices sit in triode, so each side presents a small-signal
*   resistance R = 1/(K_L*(Vov_L - Vdrop)) with K_L = mu_p*Cox*(W/L)_L and
*   Vov_L = sqrt(2*Iref/K_ref).  The input pair contributes gm_in = sqrt(2*I*K_in).
*   Writing u = Vov_L/Vdrop, the differential gain collapses to
*
*       Av = sqrt(2*K_in/K_L) * f(u),   f(u) = sqrt(u-0.5)/(u-1),
*       u  = 2*(Iref/Iin)*(K_L/K_ref).
*
*   u depends only on current ratios and geometry ratios of like devices, and
*   sqrt(K_in/K_L) only on the electron/hole mobility ratio, so the gain tracks
*   sqrt(mu_n/mu_p) instead of gm*R -- that ratio moves only ~3% over the whole
*   process/temperature space, while gm*R with a fixed resistor moves >40%.
*
* Sizing rules used (all ratios are exact device ratios, not tuned values)
*   * Every matched pair shares one model bin: identical l and identical w/nf,
*     differing only in integer nf.  Binned Sky130 models change vth0/u0 at bin
*     edges, so mixing bins would make the ratios process dependent.
*        XMB/XMT/XMN  l=4.0  w/nf=3.2  nf=64/128/32 -> 50uA/100uA/25uA
*        XMR/XML1/XML2 l=3.5525 w/nf=3.2 nf=1/4      -> u = 4
*   * Long channels on the bias mirror (l=4) keep its output conductance low so
*     the reference current, and therefore Vov_L and the gain, barely move when
*     the supply shifts the nb node.
*   * l=3.5 on the input pair and l=3.5525 on the loads sit in bins where the
*     mobility-ratio temperature drift is smallest (~0.6% over -40..125C).
*
* Nominal (tt, 27C, 1.80V): Av=3.50, VDD-Vout,CM=230mV, BW=44MHz, 312uW.
* Over all 27 PVT points: Av 3.43..3.68 (ratio 1.074), drop 188..285mV,
* BW 35..54MHz, power <=346uW, output imbalance 0.
